caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted female figure standing atop an intricately carved ornamental base. The figure is dressed in a long, flowing garment decorated with symmetrical scrollwork and floral details at the hem and sleeve edges, colored in shades of beige, brown, and off-white. Her bodice is fitted and accentuated with round buttons down the front, and her arms are bent at the elbows, one holding a part of the skirt which is lifted to reveal the knee and leg beneath. The sleeves are long and puffed, and her hair is styled in curls that are bound with a ribbon at the back. The base beneath the figure is elaborately designed with swirling patterns and leaf motifs, rendered in similar earthy hues, and the entire composition is set against a neutral, light-colored background. There is a noticeable dark crack running vertically through the figure's dress, adding detail to the depiction of the sculpture's age or material.
title: Figurehead
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
